primary_generation_source.interpretation: Generator uses randomized same-day minute timestamps. The explicit temporal branch samples session times independently and uses either a supplied question timestamp or another sampled timestamp; the knowledge-update branch separately assigns random times to sorted calendar dates. This is consistent with, but does not prove, a benchmark timestamp-granularity mismatch.

limits: A complete normalized dated-turn substring in baseline is text presence, not certified source identity; two matched turn occurrences share identical stamped text within one question scope.
All 1,475 future session occurrences are later by minute timestamp but on the question calendar date; the supplied benchmark history and strict production as_of are distinct contracts.
This does not establish that the historical 423/500 score is invalid, that answer correctness changes, or that using later-than-question timestamps is appropriate for production.
Do not silently change the frozen strict full-timestamp cutoff or reinterpret prior readiness gates; any date-granularity benchmark variant needs a separately frozen protocol and matched audit.
